clips.title: 'Watching the Grass Grow' Is Not Fun (VOA)
clips.transcript: Imagine you are sitting in a grassy field. And you have only one job, to watch the grass grow. That does not sound very interesting. In fact, it sounds really boring.
clips.source: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories: “'Watching the Grass Grow' Is Not Fun”, written by Anna Matteo. learningenglish.voanews.com — https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/watching-the-grass-grow-is-not-fun/8003108.html

clips.title: Green Means Spring and Other Things (VOA)
clips.transcript: Green is an important color in nature. It is the color of grass and the leaves on trees. It is also the color of most growing plants.
clips.source: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories: “Green Means Spring and Other Things”, written by Marilyn Christiano (narrated by Warren Scheer and Anna Matteo). learningenglish.voanews.com — https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/words-and-their-stories-green-idioim-expressions-garden-jealousy/2688277.html

clips.title: How to 'Dish Up' Something Good (VOA)
clips.transcript: Do you have a signature dish? Our signature is how we sign our names. So, a signature dish is a dish we are known for making well. In a way, it identifies us.
clips.source: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories: “How to 'Dish Up' Something Good”, written by Anna Matteo. learningenglish.voanews.com — https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/how-to-dish-up-something-good/7980848.html

clips.title: The Importance of Being 'Dialed In' (VOA)
clips.transcript: First, let's talk about dials. These controls are used for changing settings on a piece of equipment, like a radio or old television.
clips.source: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories: “The Importance of Being 'Dialed In'”, written by Anna Matteo. learningenglish.voanews.com — https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/the-importance-of-being-dialed-in-/7979814.html

clips.title: Don't Miss a Thing With 'Eagle Eyes' (VOA)
clips.transcript: I ask myself several important questions. What is the overall goal? Who is the main focus? What resources do I have available to me?
clips.source: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories: “Don't Miss a Thing With 'Eagle Eyes'”, written by Anna Matteo. learningenglish.voanews.com — https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/don-t-miss-a-thing-with-eagle-eyes-/7963085.html

clips.title: What Does It Take to Be a 'Power Couple'? (VOA)
clips.transcript: If we say two people are joined at the hip, they are nearly always together. If we describe individuals as thick as thieves, it means they are very close.
clips.source: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories: “What Does It Take to Be a 'Power Couple'?”, written by Anna Matteo. learningenglish.voanews.com — https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/what-does-it-take-to-be-a-power-couple-/7963076.html

clips.title: 'Kitchen-Table' Is a Type of Politics (VOA)
clips.transcript: The kitchen is often considered the hub or center of the home. It is where we gather to not only share a meal, but to talk about the events of the day.
clips.source: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories: “'Kitchen-Table' Is a Type of Politics”, written by Anna Matteo. learningenglish.voanews.com — https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/what-are-kitchen-table-politics-/7953635.html

clips.title: Sometimes We 'Spread Ourself Too Thin' (VOA)
clips.transcript: However, if we try to do too much, we may spread ourselves too thin. This expression means we have taken on too much. We are pushed to the limit.
clips.source: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories: “Sometimes We 'Spread Ourself Too Thin'”, written by Anna Matteo. learningenglish.voanews.com — https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/sometimes-we-spread-ourself-too-thin-/7940837.html

clips.title: Knee Jerk and Gut Reactions: When We Are Not in Control (VOA)
clips.transcript: And other decisions and actions are not well thought out. We make them quickly, without thinking, almost like a pure physical reaction.
clips.source: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories: “Knee Jerk and Gut Reactions: When We Are Not in Control”, written by Anna Matteo. learningenglish.voanews.com — https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/knee-jerk-when-you-are-not-in-control-/7937763.html

clips.title: The Story of Jack Frost (VOA)
clips.transcript: When temperatures drop and a cold snap comes, that means one thing. Jack Frost has arrived. Jack Frost represents the coming of dark, cold days.
clips.source: VOA Learning English, Words and Their Stories: “The Story of Jack Frost”, written by Anna Matteo. learningenglish.voanews.com — https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/the-story-of-jack-frost-/7932530.html
